name: session-decisions
description: Keeps the decisions and actions an assistant is waiting on you for in the session task list: numbered D1, A1, ..., checked for a recommendation and a link, re-shown after compaction, and shown as cards in the transcript and a sidebar, with a count in the footer.

forge_hosts.title: Forge hosts
forge_hosts.description: Forges the plugin can't tell from the host name, as host=kind entries split by commas; kind is github, gitlab, forgejo or gitea. For example: git.lab.example.com=forgejo, code.example.com=gitlab. An entry here wins over the built-in rules for its host.

handoff_check.title: Hand-off check
handoff_check.description: When a reply hands you work ("left for you", "you'll need to merge") that isn't in the decision queue, show a warning and remind the assistant to queue it on its next turn.
